rules.name: OrderLookup5xx
rules.query: sum by (http_route) (increase(order_lookup_requests_total{http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[2m])) or on (http_route) sum by (http_route) (0 * order_lookup_requests_total)

annotations.description: HTTP 5xx counter increased over the last 2 minutes on {{ $labels.http_route }}. Evaluated every 10 seconds with no pending delay. Inspect the dashboard, correlated Loki logs and Tempo traces.
